methods.what: Mean value property of a harmonic function: value at the centre equals the average over the circle
Reflection principle across the imaginary axis: if u=0 on x=0, the function is continued by mapping u+vi to -u+vi at the point -x+yi
Reflection (inversion) across a circle of radius r centred at a, expressed through logarithms and the conjugate point z'
Inversion formulas in a circle in algebraic form
